name: WatercolourWashField
job: Paint a slow watercolour wash behind content that blooms in from the edges as the block enters view, pigment pooling at the borders
visitor_action: scroll in; pointing at the paper rewets it and the pigment blooms again
owner_settings: Headline, paragraph, button label and link
mobile: sim resolution scales to the block; touch rewets the paper with a fingertip; motion stops when the wash dries or the block leaves the screen
motion: clear water sweeps the field in strokes, indigo and sap-green pigment diffuses wet-on-wet for ~6s while cauliflower blooms erupt and pigment granulates into the paper, then the wash dries completely (rims darken, sheen fades, all motion stops); text rises in a blurred stagger; pointing at the paper rewets it (reduced-motion: the finished dry wash renders instantly, text shown at once)

checks.render: pending: builder sandbox blocked all browser spawns (Chrome SIGABRT under seatbelt) so shot.sh could not run; sim+shader verified via a node port rendering the wash offline (indigo/sap-green diffusion, blooms, granulation confirmed); DOM layer verified by tsc, Vite transform and layout arithmetic — orchestrator review must re-run shot.sh

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Wet-on-wet: simulated pigment diffusion with cauliflower blooms and granulation on cold-press paper; indigo and sap green, natural-white sheet, light mode
notes: WebGL-only wash (static CSS-gradient fallback if WebGL is missing); engine is a cellular fluid sim + Beer-Lambert shader, not a video. 2026-11-23: redesigned (batch B) to wet-on-wet indigo/sap green with self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque + Hanken Sans; removed the eyebrow setting per contract §10.
